Visit note | 2025-03-18 02:30 PM | Dr. Sharmin Akter, Obstetrics and Gynecology | Patient: Orin Ahmed, 31, female. Ms. Ahmed consults because she has noticed weight gain, extra hair on her face, and acne. She mentions that these concerns started and she first noticed the weight gain after beginning a desk job in Noakhali. She works as a graphic designer and lives with her family. Her medical history is negative for any chronic illness, and she reports no other systemic complaints. On examination, her vital signs are as follows: BMI 25.8, BP 133/76 mmHg, pulse 73 bpm, weight 54 kg. Notably, she has had no periods for six months with no acne or weight gain during this presentation check. Assessment: Polycystic ovary syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued for her management. She was advised to aim for 5% weight loss, exercise 150 minutes a week, and reduce sugary drinks. Follow-up is scheduled in 3 months.

Visit note | 2025-03-18 03:00 PM | Dr. Imran Kabir, Gastroenterology | Patient: Dipali Das, 65, female. Mrs. Das reports experiencing pain that eases after eating and gnawing pain in the upper belly. She states this started after weeks of taking painkillers for back pain in Lalbagh. She works as a farmer and has a known history of Essential hypertension. She was advised to avoid painkillers such as ibuprofen, stop smoking, and eat regular meals. Follow-up in 4 weeks with a stool H. pylori test.

Visit note | 2025-03-18 03:30 PM | Dr. Saiful Alam, Endocrinology | Patient: Papiya Mondol, 72, female.
